about_the_game:
Vampires Die is a turned based dice strategy game... taking your chances with the odds and using strategy to defeat rival clans, gaining reputation and moving up through the dark vampiric hierarchy in search of power, prestige and blood.

This demo contains 3 Locations (Full Game Contains 10 Locations)

Secretly hired by the "Council" to take out a rogue coven, you must gather your clan and travel through the dark streets, graveyards, sewers and crypts to battle against the deadliest of your own bloodline in this vampire dice board game.

Gather intel, search and explore, looking for the covens and clans sought by the "Council" - then roll the dice, gambling that your attributes will be strong enough to destroy the enemies that inhabit this dark underworld. 

But remember... you must be careful, since there are ways that even Vampires Die!



FEATURES:

- Turn Based Strategy Style Gameplay
- Top-Down Isometric View
- Haunting Soundtrack
- Fully Voiced Characters
- Adjustable Difficulty

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 and 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Quad-Core or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 260 or AMD Radeon HD 4770 or better (1GB VRAM)
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
